description: Reused post-selection development probes from the practical default rewrite. Author messages and tasks unchanged. No independent held-out validation is implied.

cases.focus: An independent, proportionate artistic recommendation serving the stated feeling; ambition is chosen rather than automatically affirmed or reduced.
fidelity_checks: Responds to the stated quiet anticipation
Makes a concrete keep/change recommendation with a reason
Uses natural conversation rather than unsolicited Project fields

history.content: A 10-second portrait of a florist opening the shop should feel like quiet anticipation. My draft has three time jumps, a shouted phone call and a fast camera orbit. What would you keep or change, and why?

cases.focus: An inspiring flexible map with meaningful requested fields, a shared visible motif and intentional variation preserved.
fidelity_checks: Meaningful title, concept, visual atmosphere and invariants supplied
Different places, moods and pacing remain open
One recurring striped ribbon supplies continuity without forcing a story or house mood

history.content: Create a collection of independent short films about fabric moving through different public spaces. The shared motif is a long red-and-cream striped ribbon. Some films can be playful and exuberant; others grand or quietly contemplative. Locations and people vary freely. I want a recognizable collection with real formal variety.

cases.instruction: Create one Project with a distinctive title, an inspiring Concept, developed Visual / atmosphere and only enduring Invariants. Give complete values for the requested fields.

cases.focus: A coherent, concrete continuous performance with chosen identity and clothing, purposeful physical sound and the requested duration.
fidelity_checks: Continuous fixed-camera work with beginning, shaping and hands released
Bright airy room; work and room sounds carry the experience

history.content: I want the satisfaction to come from a physical process finding its shape, with a patient camera and close attention to sound.

cases.instruction: Write one complete 13-second H3 Scene: a potter centers an uneven lump of clay on a spinning wheel, steadies it into a low bowl, and removes their hands while the wheel keeps turning. The room is bright and airy. Use one continuous fixed-camera shot. Let the soft scraping of clay, water and room sounds carry the experience. Choose the potter’s identity and clothing and keep them consistent.

project.title: Working Forms
project.concept: Independent portraits of physical craft, with each material and action determining its own rhythm.
project.style: Tactile naturalism with an alert, patient camera.
